title: Leverage new Ghidra filetype icon feature for RetroGhidra loaders
description:
Your PR 'Let FileSystem extensions set filetype icons in filesystem browser' was merged into upstream Ghidra (Oct 2024, commit 87c5523a06).

This enables RetroGhidra loaders to specify custom icons for file types in the Ghidra filesystem browser. Currently, loaders rely on file extensions only.

Audit existing loaders and add FileAttributeType.FILETYPE_ICON where appropriate (e.g., Apple II disk images, cartridge formats, etc.)

title: Evaluate IDE alternatives to Eclipse for Ghidra development
description:
Eclipse is painful. Explore whether VSCode, IntelliJ IDEA, or Zed can be used for Ghidra extension development:

Per user notes: VSCode has 2nd-best existing support but might still not be ideal.

Research needed:
- VSCode: Ghidra language server, extension templates, debugging setup
- IntelliJ IDEA: Java project setup, Gradle integration, Ghidra plugin compatibility
- Zed: Feasibility for Java development, Ghidra ecosystem support
- Required: Debugging, building, testing within the IDE

Goal: Find at least one viable alternative or recommend best practices for each

title: Investigate Kotlin support for Ghidra extensions/plugins
description:
Current RetroGhidra is pure Java. Exploring whether Ghidra extensions can be written in Kotlin:

Research needed:
- Can Kotlin code be compiled and used as Ghidra plugins?
- How would Gradle build configuration change?
- Any classpath/runtime issues with Kotlin stdlib?
- Would it simplify the codebase vs Java?
- Are there existing Kotlin-based Ghidra extensions as reference?

Goal: Determine feasibility and effort to port RetroGhidra (or new features) to Kotlin

title: Test BinHex implementation against real .hqx files
description:
